metadata.description: Portable skills for AI agents: a multi-model advisory board for hard decisions, and a five-skill team-workflow pack for tracked, multi-session, agent-assisted development.

plugins.name: advisory-board
plugins.description: Convene a board of frontier AI models — Claude, Codex, Gemini, and Grok — that each review the same decision independently, debate across rounds, and hand back one clear recommendation.

plugins.name: team-workflow
plugins.description: Five skills that ship as one pack — a portable discipline for tracked, multi-session, agent-assisted development: a router entry point, a once-per-repo setup interview, decision maps, throwaway prototypes, and autonomous research lanes. Versioned together (team-workflow/vX.Y.Z); this version mirrors the latest pack tag.
